description: Source code implementing a menu box UI component using ncurses, including functions for rendering menu items, handling user input, scrolling, and displaying control buttons. It is part of a dialog library used in Linux kernel configuration menus.

methods.name: do_print_item
methods.description: Renders a menu item in the window, highlighting if selected and marking hotkeys.

methods.name: print_arrows
methods.description: Displays scroll indicators (up/down arrows) in the menu.

methods.name: print_buttons
methods.description: Displays control buttons (Select, Exit, Help, Save, Load) at the bottom of the dialog.

methods.name: do_scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the menu up or down by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: dialog_menu
methods.description: Main function to display a scrollable menu dialog, handle user input, and return the selected option.
